nodes.label: BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Combined brand style guide, 11-section HTML mockup prompt specification, and desktop homepage UI mockup for BabyShalls, an independent children's bookstore and educational toy shop in Malang, Indonesia.

nodes.label: BabyShalls Brand Identity
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Sun-rising-from-open-book logo mark with leaves, BabyShalls wordmark, and tagline 'Books. Toys. A Brighter Tomorrow.' for an independent bookstore and educational toy shop in Malang, Indonesia.

nodes.label: Warm Earthy Color Palette
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png

nodes.label: Typography System (Playfair Display & Nunito)
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Playfair Display (friendly & warm serif) for headings paired with Nunito (rounded sans-serif) for body text.

nodes.label: Button & Action Controls
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Pill-shaped Primary Button (#D9744A Terracotta with arrow), Secondary Button (outlined cream), Shop Now button (#CFE3C4 Sage), and circular icon buttons for Cart, Wishlist Heart, and Search.

nodes.label: Line/Flat Icon Set
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Consistent line/flat icons for Books, Toys, Hampers, Events, Shipping, Account, Cart, and WhatsApp.

nodes.label: Decorative & Badge UI Elements
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Rounded cream card containers, botanical leaf accents, dashed swirl, age/status pill badges ('Ages 1-3', 'New', 'Ages 6+'), and 5-star review icons.

nodes.label: 11-Section HTML Mockup Specification
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Structured prompt defining 11 responsive desktop homepage sections: Top bar, Header, Navigation, Hero, Shop by Age, New Arrivals, Gift Hampers banner, Workshops & Events, Reviews strip, Footer, and Floating WhatsApp button.

nodes.label: Top Bar, Header & Navigation
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Top bar with 'Free gift wrapping for hampers' and 'Chat us on WhatsApp'; header with logo, search bar ('Search for books or toys...'), account & cart icons; nav links: Shop by Age, Books, Toys, Hampers & Gifts, Workshops & Events, About, Request a Book.

nodes.label: Hero Banner Section
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Hero featuring a photo of a child reading surrounded by wooden toys, headline 'Find the right book for your little one', subtext 'Carefully selected imported books and educational toys.', and 'Shop by Age' CTA.

nodes.label: Shop by Age Section
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Four illustrated age-group cards: Newborn+, Ages 1-3, Ages 3+, and Ages 6+.

nodes.label: New Arrivals Product Grid
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: 4-column product grid with age badges, Rupiah prices, and wishlist hearts: Look and Grow: Nature Board Book (Rp175.500), Forest Friends Picture Book (Rp189.000), Wooden Rainbow Stacker (Rp249.000), Wooden Shape Sorter (Rp299.000).

nodes.label: Gift Hampers Banner
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Promotional banner reading 'Gift Hampers — Thoughtful gifts for curious kids.' with 'Explore Hampers' CTA and wrapped gift box photo.

nodes.label: Workshops & Events Section
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Two event cards at BabyShalls, Malang with 'Learn more' buttons: 'Little Explorers: Nature Craft Workshop' (Sat, May 24, 2025) and 'Play & Learn: Wooden Toys Session' (Sat, Jun 7, 2025).

nodes.label: Customer Reviews Strip
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Social proof strip displaying 5.0 stars, '359 happy reviews', and two customer testimonials from Sarah (Malang) and Rani (Surabaya).

nodes.label: Footer & Floating WhatsApp CTA
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Terracotta footer with Malang address (Jl. Cempaka No. 12, Malang, Jawa Timur), opening hours (Open daily 10.00 - 17.00), social icons, payment icons (VISA, Mastercard, BCA), and a floating green WhatsApp chat button in the bottom right.

nodes.label: Warm & Approachable Family Storefront Rationale
nodes.source_file: frontend/public/BabyShalls Warm Style Guide and Homepage Mockup-2.png
nodes.description: Combines warm cream/peach/terracotta/sage tones, rounded Nunito body text, friendly Playfair Display headings, botanical motifs, and age-segmented browsing to make curated children's books and wooden toys approachable for parents in Indonesia.
